Findings.Comment: `Touch` now treats its TTL as milliseconds and passes it to `PExpire`, but the only visible caller still passes seconds: `internal/session/manager.go:58` calls `m.store.Touch(ctx, id, int64(m.idle.Seconds()))`. On a realistic idle TTL of 30s the store now sets a 30ms expiry, so every touched session drops out of Redis almost immediately and lookups miss right after refresh. Either the caller must switch to `Milliseconds()` or the store must keep interpreting seconds.

Expected.why: The unchanged caller still passes seconds to a parameter that now means milliseconds: sessions expire 1000 times too early.
